data.body: **[P2] Record whether an inline envelope requires its producer's offloader.** This dispatches every envelope to the consumer-configured offloader, but v1 does not distinguish active-offloader `INLINE` data from an SDK marker-escape envelope. Across chained invokes or configuration changes, disabled-policy data can therefore be passed through an unrelated transforming offloader, while active-offloader data can bypass required `load` semantics when none is configured. Add an envelope origin/`requiresLoad` field and dispatch from that metadata; cover disabled-to-active and active-to-missing-offloader cases.
